svg.aria-label: Azo coupling = electrophilic aromatic substitution by the diazonium ion
svg.title: Azo coupling = electrophilic aromatic substitution by the diazonium ion
svg.desc: Mechanism of azo coupling between benzenediazonium and phenoxide giving p-hydroxyazobenzene
svg.text: Azo coupling = electrophilic aromatic substitution by the diazonium ion
The –N=N– bridge joins the two rings; the electron-rich partner (phenol, naphthol, amine) is the coupling component.
If the para position is blocked, coupling occurs at the ortho position.
